scope: Authentication reliability only: stale/duplicate OAuth callback recovery and single-flight login actions. Preserves v314 Full Zone domains, v313 Nara, v312 Theme Studio/members, v311 onboarding, v310 Posts/Pages and the existing Studio sidebar.
notes: If Supabase returns an OAuth-state-expired/consumed callback but a valid persisted session already exists, Studio now recovers that session instead of showing a false login failure.
Fast repeated taps on a login action are guarded so the browser does not launch overlapping OAuth flows from the same modal.
A real invalid login without a valid session still returns an error; this release does not manufacture a session.
No logout, localStorage.clear, sessionStorage.clear or forced page reload was added.
